svg.title: HALO H2 architecture: one system, Light and Dark
svg.desc: Twelve symbolic positions with a rigid front two-thirds and underside adjustment. Month 1 has one center stone and eleven blanks. Month 12 has Onyx 12 centered plus stones 01 to 11. Layout and indexing need CAD.
svg.text: DESIGN INTENT / SCHEMATIC ONLY — spacing, curvature and indexing unresolved
Rigid visible/front ≈2/3 • 12 positions • rear adjustment remains visually subordinate
01 + eleven clean blanks → 12 centered + previous eleven retained. Same stones and geometry in both finishes.
Position map is symbolic: it does not select a moving mechanism, equal pitch, chassis dimensions or final wrist range.
